title: The way google used to be
content:
I’m giving this 4 instead of 5 because the last few updates have been following a worrying trend that makes me fear perplexity will go the way of most apps and downgrade to the point of being a shadow of its former self. Not there yet - still incredible - but soon I foresee a mandatory sign up and less accurate answers on the horizon….
In the meantime, this app has reinvented the internet as an information source. It reminds of me of google way back (waaay back) when google actually answered your questions. It’s been many many years since I stopped bothering to look anything up on google because of the terrible unrelated results. But then came perplexity - free, no passwords and logins, just direct and accurate answers to your questions in a half second. Every time. No fuss, no sponsored results. I think of it as AI that basically scours a google search result and instantly weeds out the garbage and irrelevant info and quickly and accurately gives you the answer to your question. No fuss no muss. Makes searching the web useful and fast again. I use it every day. Multiple times. For all types of questions. And I recommend it to everyone. That said - I hope they don’t keep changing it or go the path of most excellent apps and break what isn’t broken. Still the best thing to happen to the web since old school google. De-clutters and intelligently searches search engines and gets straight to the point. Amazing and should be the number one app priority for everyone.
